Episode 257. The Demon Army' Attack (10)
It was the point where they had no choice but to sacrifice the superhumans.
[Ah, if I knew it would be like this, I should have just come to the Black Sea with you from the start, right? Jin. We're not too late, are we?]
Orgal was the first to spread his wings and emerge from the dimensional gate. Behind him, the fleets of Kinzelo and Runcandel's Golden Fleet were revealing their majesty.
[Chiron! My grandson, where are you! This old grandfather finally gets to see you!]

Following that, Valas's booming voice echoed across the battlefield. Chiron looked back at his grandfather, whom he was reuniting with after several decades, and smirked. Grandfather is still the same as ever, he thought.

The fleet strength of Runcandel and Kinzelo, numbering about a thousand ships combined, exited the dimensional gate in an instant and took their positions. For now, the coalition no longer needed to sacrifice their superhumans to face the enemy Genesis Knights.

The enemies gritted their teeth at the sight of the allied forces that had suddenly joined the battle. At this rate, they would start to be pushed back in the fleet battle as well, so the Demon Army had to make the choice to send out their troops faster than planned. A choice that was bound to come with a great price.

The two Genesis Knights of the Demon Army who were just about to make their move were also retreating to the rear. From now on, they were scheduled to take on the absurd role of having to somehow survive the coalition's fierce onslaught until the next Genesis Knights could emerge from the dimensional gate.
The fleets of Kinzelo and Runcandel did not immediately commence firing. First, they needed to secure the positions of their allies within the enemy lines and coordinate with the existing fleet.

The White Fleet also showed a movement of ceasing its bombardment and tidying its ranks. In other words, the bombardments of both the coalition and the Demon Army had temporarily stopped, and the battlefield was entering a temporary lull for the first time.
Over two thousand fleets from both sides, troops filling the ground...

To the point where it was hard to believe such a fierce battle had been taking place until just a moment ago, the battlefield became quiet in an instant. Only the heavy vibration of the power sources, as the fleets of each faction realigned their formations, was echoing.
In the midst of it, Jin looked back at his allies once, then took a step towards the enemy.

“Just now, the most faithful servant of the coalition, the Ghost Leader Rata Procchi, was struck by the enemy's dagger and met his death. Those who loved and cherished him as I did, you must remember this day. To the very end, Rata Procchi did not spare his own life for the victory of the coalition over his own safety.”
Jin beat his chest several times in his honor. A deep sound, like a distant drum, echoed.
“Today is a day when any of us could leave this world while fighting. Not just today, but from now on, every day will be such a day until we have torn every last one of those bastards to shreds.”
Soon, Jin raised his sword.

“It is an exhausting fight, a sad fight, and a disadvantageous fight. I express my gratitude to all who are standing together in this place. If I were to die on the battlefield, the only last words I would leave would be that I was proud of you all.”
[Last words? What kind of unlucky talk is that? Spit, spit, spit. I've spat to ward off the bad luck. It's not you who should be leaving last words, but those gutter-like bastards.]

“That's right, Orgal. So, Demon Army, I would like to ask you one thing as well. What are you fighting for? For what did you become the dogs of Kelliark, and for what are you enduring this terrible battlefield? What words, what feelings do you wish to leave behind when you die.”
He was genuinely curious.

How so many people could throw away their lives for the desire of a single person, for the desire of a single group, to achieve the unification of all dimensions; how even Genesis Knights could show such unconditional obedience.
No answer was heard. The Demon Army silently tidied their ranks.

“From what I see, you have no conviction. Even if you do, it would be nothing but the broken and twisted remnants of it, by the tyrant named Kelliark Zipple. What can you gain by conquering all dimensions? Is it such a glorious thing to complete a world manipulated just for you by a Origin Stone?”
Soldiers whose pride has been castrated, you are wrong.
Jin continued his words and beat his chest once more. Everyone in the coalition watching him was beating their chests.

“Among the numerous worlds that exist in all dimensions, the one and only right answer is right here. It is standing in this place. If you still have not realized that fact, there is only one future that awaits you. That is to die more than us, and to ultimately be destroyed and disappear!”
The tip of Bradamante was aimed at the enemies.
At that moment, the coalition's fleet advanced and began its bombardment, and the superhumans were seen descending to the ground and rushing towards the enemies.
The fight that had begun again was the same as before.
The Vamel Alliance, with its reinforcements having arrived, showed a slightly superior aspect, but the Demon Army was also sending out the troops on standby inside the dimensional gate faster.

The superhumans were still letting out roars as they faced the Elonas of the Holy Army and the elites of the Demon Army, and the Genesis Knights were penetrating to the deepest parts of the enemy lines to track the enemy Genesis Knights.
However, the resonance was different.
The coalition members, who had been growing tired in the bloody battle that had continued for nearly 40 hours, heard Jin's voice and once again thought about what they were.
What they were fighting for, what they were enduring this hell to protect.
It was for their lives.
It was for all the memories in this world, which to the Demon Army was just 'dimension number 677' until Jin came to prominence, and for the people who shared those memories.
Not everyone had only good intentions from the start when they joined the Vamel Alliance. Some had joined for success, some for survival, some to follow the trend.

But even those people were now all becoming of one mind. That they had to fight to protect this world and their lives, that they absolutely had to, as much as they had enjoyed the benefits as 'the Vamel Alliance.'
So to speak, a sense of debt was now taking root in the inner selves of the coalition members.
That was a feeling that exactly matched the sense of debt, the worry, that Jin had held as the sole regressor.
Among those fighting in this place to stand against the Demon Army, there was no one who did not owe a debt to this world.

[Kuhahaha, grandson! The more I see you, the luckier a fellow you are! All you did was struggle your whole life, yet you met such a good grandfather and have such excellent children. Wasn't my great-grandson magnificent just now? What's certain is that his talent for words does not resemble yours, kuhahat!]
“G-grandfather, don't overdo it. You can't die again. You only have one arm.”
[Alright, Yona! Well then, we're off to catch those things, so work hard, grandson, and you Genesis Knight fellows!]
Following Valas's hearty voice, the knights of Runcandel were unfolding a sword formation. Next to them, the superhumans of the coalition were gathering, centered around Dante and Veradin.
“Damn it, what's that again. Just how far are these bastards planning to insult Lady Elona?”

“Indeed, Lord Veradin. Hmph, for now, it would be best for us to find a way to support Jin's side while tying down those Elona-form weapons. Since the enemies possess too many Genesis Knights, we must be able to join them at any time.”

Dante was, by all means, the core among the superhumans. Just like right before the reinforcements arrived, he was the person who, along with Hedo, would be of the greatest help when the Genesis Knights' side suddenly needed the support of the superhumans.

However, in Dante's eyes, he could not see a way to open a path at all. Now that the front line had become like this, the enemy Genesis Knights would surely appear from the rear, and the distance would inevitably be far from the allied Genesis Knights as well.
While Dante was momentarily contemplating as he cut down enemies, one person approached his side. Eltiot, the great Bluebird tribesman who had achieved the status of a Genesis Knight of 'Harmony.'

Although he was a Genesis Knight, his body was broken so he could not display a comparable martial prowess, but the authority of harmony he possessed could still sufficiently influence the entire battlefield.

“Tsk! You rascal, do not rest for even a moment from cutting down enemies while having useless worries. From now on, I will coordinate the entire rear guard. I will form a front line so that those like you and Hedo can join the Genesis Knights' side at any time, and so that the ground troops can fight as safely as possible. From now on, whenever you see me, follow my footwork exactly as you fight.”
Dante immediately moved according to Eltiot's footwork as he had said. At that, surprisingly, he felt as if a path that had been invisible to his eyes was slowly being revealed.

From that point on, a blue wind of harmony began to bloom across the entire battlefield. Eltiot moved between the battlefield like the wind, continuously fixing the ranks of his allies, and while doing so, he was displaying the divine skill of repeatedly returning to the vicinity of Dante and Hedo to open a new path for them.
At times, he would even enter the Genesis Knights' battlefield and drive a fleeing enemy Genesis Knight towards the allied Genesis Knights. All of this was something that only he could do.
“Luna, you are using your crimson sword too thickly! At this rate, you will not be able to endure the remaining time, so restrain yourself a little more!”
“Yes, Master!”
“And Chiron, your body has also been damaged from using your ultimate technique until just now. Rest for 5 seconds. I will tie down those bastards' feet for that long in your stead.”
The time remaining until Ameris could undo the curse left on Temar's body was now about 80 hours.

The Vamel Alliance was literally pouring its full strength into this war, and in that process, all the coalition members had finished their deliberations. They had once again keenly felt the reason they were fighting, and had looked back on their lives.
However, as time went on, the enemies, the members of the Demon Army, were deliberating. They could not help but be conscious of the words Jin had said.
What am I?
At some point, it had become a question to which they no longer knew the answer.
